question: What happens to ritual performers who lack liberating knowledge?
premises: Those who perform sacrifices and offerings but lack knowledge go to heaven.
When the fruit of that heaven is exhausted, they do not remain there.
By the remainder of their merit they return to the human world.
inference: Ritual merit without knowledge grants only a temporary ascent to heaven followed by return to human birth.
plain_english: Those who perform sacrifices and other rites but lack knowledge go to heaven. When that merit is exhausted, they return to the human world because of the merit that still remains.
